audio_output: Native answer text, audio-segment evidence and uncertainty; generated speech is disabled.
audio_notes: Local add, update, delete, link and no-change functions preserve audio references and earlier versions; no oracle transcript is stored in the model-visible memory.
audio_phase: Feasibility only: question transcription, silent-audio control, increasing history, labelled voices and a single earlier note-call test. Full per-chunk note evaluation is not yet run.
audio_input_rules: Ground-truth transcripts and reference answers are evaluation-only.
The user question is supplied as audio, not as its known text.
Voice examples precede the relevant cutoff; missing identities remain unknown.
No future audio is read and no history is silently trimmed.
Model encoder windows may be shorter than the 10–40-second thinking intervals; the note-update boundaries stay fixed.
evaluation: Accuracy uses source-reviewed fact checklists and native answer text; no response ASR is needed.
Audio-only identities are resolved from cited speech in evaluation, not by comparing arbitrary predicted labels with AMI letters.
Report exposed request-time thinking tokens separately from earlier note-generation tokens; use not exposed when no native reasoning channel is available.
Report first-answer/completion time, audio input tokens and all earlier encoding/note cost; match cache conditions between reactive and notes.
next_steps: Complete the text diagnostic and source-review all 144 answers before releasing accuracy.
Qualify full audio-history processing and actual note-call execution for both models.
Then run the reactive/function-note comparison under both speaker-identity conditions on a small matched set.
